protocol_note: The connector exposes create/replace file operations but no append primitive, and the append-only STARTS.jsonl cannot be safely reconstructed from the truncated connector view without risking concurrent-record loss. This additive main-visible record is therefore used as a non-destructive fallback before any implementation write; STARTS.jsonl itself is left untouched.
